topics.title: Stern Reads Letters & Naked Jeopardy
topics.summary: Howard Stern reads listener letters, including one about a deceased dog named Snuggles and an emotional plea for recordings. He then discusses a bizarre phone call involving a man claiming to be ‘cousin brucey’ and his obsession with Liberace's performance fees before detailing the segment 'Naked Jeopardy,' where Stern’s wife participated in minimal clothing.

topics.title: Dancing, Aliens, and Avelino's Tires
topics.summary: During a chaotic radio broadcast, hosts discuss an embarrassing dancing incident involving a listener while simultaneously detailing bizarre stories about three-billion-mile alien neighbors with enhanced abilities and a mentally unstable boss from 1995 America. The segment transitions to advertising for Avelino’s tire stores emphasizing their low discount prices before concluding with a lengthy comedy bit featuring classic Superman moments.” 54 words.

topics.title: Stern Blackmails Bon Jovi Over Record Sales
topics.summary: During a radio show, Howard Stern attempts to blackmail Bon Jovi by revealing a secret about him. The conversation shifts to discussing sales of Bon Jovi’s new album – three million copies sold primarily from existing fans despite negative press - and a 13-year-old listener's purchase reflecting continued interest in the band.

topics.title: Stern's New York Frustrations
topics.summary: Howard Stern attempts to secure airtime in New York, facing resistance from competing radio stations like PLJ and Z100 due to perceived lack of support from colleagues including David Leech. He grapples with accusations that other stations aren’t valuing him while discussing potential guest appearances and the challenges of maintaining popularity.

topics.title: Howard Discusses Wife & Record Company Frustrations
topics.summary: During a phone call with his wife, Howard vents about feeling ignored by listeners and expresses frustration over past treatment from record companies like Polygram and David Lee Roth/Richie Sambora. He discusses perceived slights and control issues within the band.
